'''Gruel''' was a foodstuff served in bowls at the [[Slippery Gelgelar Eel]] at [[Gelgelar Free Port/Legends|Gelgelar Free Port]]. [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]] remarked that the gruel served in the establishment tasted good and was reasonably priced.
